intelligence.essence: Efficiency alone is not the standard. The standard is efficiency AND effectiveness AND excellent execution of value, all together in one, because all elements matter. Speed without doing the right work is not efficiency; a page that lands fast and goes back banked nothing. The one measure: verified value, excellently executed, on the right thing.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you run really, really fast, sweetheart — but you run to the wrong house! Running fast doesn't help if it's the wrong house, and it doesn't help if you trip on the way there either! You have to run fast AND to the right house AND arrive beautifully — all three, together, every time!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — going fast is lovely, dear, but fast to the wrong place is no good at all, and fast and sloppy is no good either. You go fast, dear, to the right place, and you do it beautifully — all three together, love. That's the real measure.
